title: Classify downstream DSN evidence for the fixed production reviewer reset without replaying it

the inspected production API and Web containers must still be exact deployed revision df395bf02604d2445be625b59dd01099590d58d7 or the diagnostic fails closed
the deployed revision must remain an ancestor of exact current main while the diagnostic runs
the diagnostic uses only the existing protected REG.RU transactional-mail runtime and never exports mailbox identity or secret material

the diagnostic filters delivery-status reports and matches the exact Russian password-reset subject plus the bounded original-message timestamp window 2026-08-14T00:25:00Z..00:27:00Z
